# How many reps must you hire to hit next year's number, and by when?

> How many quota-carrying reps must you hire, and by when, to hit next year's bookings target? Month-by-month ramped capacity, attrition, hiring lead time, a latest-start date per hire cohort, sensitivity, and hire-early vs hire-late cost. Free, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
